statement: ∀ v : Fin 3 → (Fin 14 → ZMod 29), 29^11 ≤ Nat.card ((Fin 14 → ZMod 29) ⧸ Submodule.span (ZMod 29) (Set.range v))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0027 · 任取三个见证在十四维剩余商仍缺至少 29¹¹ 倍
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0027 · Bound the index of any three witnesses in the fourteen-dimensional residual quotient

brief.zh: 对生成空间用秩至多三，再对商空间用有限向量空间的基数公式。
brief.en: Bound the generated dimension by three and use the cardinality of the quotient vector space.
